created_by: claude, lane infra, card X-T2 (2026-10-14); Codex reviews
about: Stage D lane registry. Plan: STAGE_D_RECONCILED_PLAN_2026-10-14.md sections 7.1 (lanes), 7.2 (this file), 7.4 (locks, takeover). Read with `python3 $OC/distill/tools/lanes.py show`; the owner heartbeats its lane (`lanes.py heartbeat --lane L --agent A ...`); lanes with a probe are heartbeated every 10 min by cron (`lanes.py pulse`) while their process lives.

rules.write: lane owner only (heartbeat); a takeover writes a takeover receipt (lanes.py takeover)
rules.takeover: only if Cyril says so (--cyril, verbatim) or the lane is transferable and its heartbeat (or registration, if it never had one) is older than 6 h; before acting: session.py sync, read the newest STATE and this file, check the live process (systemctl, docker ps, nvidia-smi, pgrep) and NEVER relaunch anything that may still be alive; after: post the five-line hand-off on Relay
rules.gpu: a GPU process starts only from the owning lane's queue/launcher under flock on $Q/gpu<N>.lock (P40s also a p40.claims line) and its own MemAvailable gate; it waits, never competes. GPU5: never.
rules.emergency_stop: host MemAvailable < 8 GiB or a thermal abort: either agent may stop the offending process, then writes a stop receipt and posts it on Relay at once
rules.heartbeat_fields: heartbeat_utc / heartbeat_by / heartbeat_source (cli, pulse, takeover, or a queue VERSION string)
